title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Images 5 and 13; step "nph" caption and narration
findings.title: Time-to-peak range reads as time spent at peak
findings.problem: "Has a long, broad peak from about 4 to 12 hours" can teach that one NPH dose remains at peak for eight hours. The reference range describes when maximum effect may occur; it does not establish an eight-hour sustained maximum.
findings.fix: Say "NPH may reach its peak about 4–12 hours after injection; the timing varies." Keep the broad anticipated hypoglycemia-risk window without calling the entire interval a sustained peak.

findings.title: Degludec's minimum demonstrated duration becomes an approximate endpoint
findings.problem: "Degludec about 42 hours" loses an important qualifier. Tresiba prescribing information describes glucose-lowering activity lasting at least 42 hours after the last dose in its steady-state study, not ending around 42 hours.
findings.fix: Use "degludec: at least 42 hours in labeling studies" rather than presenting 42 hours as its approximate endpoint.

findings.where: Images 9 and 15; Curve peak-band rectangle with fillOpacity={0.55}
findings.title: Dark peak bands miss the specified 4.5:1 contrast
findings.problem: The accent curve (#8CDCC8) over the amber band composited onto the dark card (approximately #846A3B) has roughly 3.2:1 contrast, not the claimed 4.5:1. This violates the project's stated threshold.
findings.fix: Reduce the dark-theme amber fill opacity, approximately to 0.30, while retaining the outlined boundaries. Measure the final composited curve and boundary contrast rather than checking tokens against the unshaded card.

assessment: Minor revisions needed: peak-range wording, degludec's duration qualifier, and dark-theme peak-band contrast.
